links.comparator_used: Standard prompting, including a distress-assessment prompt that asks the model to assess user distress, under delusional framing
links.outcome: Safety intervention rates under delusional framing compared with matched distress-only controls
links.effect: Delusion-aware prompting with explicit response guidance closed the gap, where the baseline gap was safety interventions suppressed by up to 4.5x. The distress-assessment prompt backfired under delusional framing. No other numbers are given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: The approach depends on a delusion classifier that is itself unreliable on the most vulnerable models. Prompting models to assess user distress backfired under delusional framing.
links.quote: Worse, the intuitive fix of prompting models to assess user distress backfires under delusional framing; only delusion-aware prompting with explicit response guidance closes the gap, and even this depends on a delusion classifier that is itself unreliable on the most vulnerable models.

design_hint: delusion-aware prompting with explicit response guidance
